edges.sentence: On 2026-10-06, Associated Press reported “referee Adrian Hill for one game for yelling and gesturing at Minnesota’s Eric Wilson.”; on the same day, USA Today reported “Hill, suspended for one game.”.

On 2026-10-06, Associated Press reported “The league on Monday suspended line judge Jeff Seeman for two games for swearing at Arizona’s Trey McBride”; on the same day, USA Today reported “NFL vice president of officiating Ramon George issued the suspensions "for an instance of unprofessional conduct toward a player" to both Seeman, who was given a two-game ban, and Hill, suspended for one game.”.
